subject: Pricing sanity check + pilot estimate and next steps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@clearsense.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing sanity check + pilot estimate and next steps

Hi Emily — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can align on an estimate for the pilot: 

1) Usage assumptions you shared: 250M tokens/month baseline, peak ~900M/month during training/ingestion windows. Confirm if those are still the right bands.
2) Target unit economics: you mentioned wanting to keep evaluation at about $10k / 1M tokens (target for executive review). Is that the preferred benchmark for the pilot?
3) Deployment preference: hosted API to start (fastest) vs dedicated pool (if you need consistent latency / data isolation). Please mark preference.

I attached a quick workbook (RI_Clearsense_pricing_pilot_estimate_v1.xlsx) with two scenarios: Hosted vs Dedicated, and a line-item cost breakdown (model cost, IO, token processing, KV cache amortization). Top-line numbers are rough — I highlighted the rows where changing sequence length or caching materially moves the $/1M.

Next steps I propose: you confirm the monthly token bands and preferred deployment, and we’ll send a formal pilot invoice + a simple contract (30-day pilot, optional ramp to reserved capacity). If procurement wants a single PDF with line-item invoice, I can get Marissa to draft it.

Thanks,
Sergio
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: RI_Clearsense_pricing_pilot_estimate_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 82 KB)
From: Emily Zhao <emily@clearsense.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 13:16:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pricing sanity check + pilot estimate and next steps

Thanks Sergio — great session. A few clarifications from my side: 

- Token bands: yes, 250M baseline is correct; 900M is a realistic peak. We can commit to a 6-month pilot range of 250M–600M tokens / month and expect occasional spikes to 900M.
- Budget: our finance lead gave a soft budget target: 7k–11k per 1M tokens for pilot evaluation (we know that varies by model/latency). Can you show scenarios at $7k and $11k per 1M?
- Deployment: prefer hosted to start for speed; if Dedicated pricing + SLA is close, we may consider a later move.

Also procurement asked whether you can include an itemized line for observability/retention (30d vs 90d) and any per-token cost for embeddings/auxiliary calls.

Cc'ing procurement: procurement@clearsense.ai for visibility.

Emily Zhao
VP Product | Clearsense
emily@clearsense.ai
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@clearsense.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing sanity check + pilot estimate and next steps

Emily — thanks, this is perfect. Attached is an updated calculator (Clearsense_pricing_calc_v2.xlsx) that includes the two scenarios you asked for ($7k and $11k / 1M tokens) plus toggles for: average seq len (256/512/1024), cache hit rate, and embedding call volume (tokens + fixed per-embed unit). Top-line highlights in the workbook: 

- Hosted scenario (no reserved capacity): at 250M tokens/month, $/1M -> $10,900 (baseline model L7x) given our default sequence length 512 and 18% cache hit. At 600M tokens, economies of scale reduce to ~$9,100 / 1M.
- Dedicated scenario (reserved pool + commitment): with a 6-month reserved commit we can reach $7,900 / 1M at 600M tokens, and ~ $8,500 / 1M at 250M because of reservation amortization.

Per your ask about observability: 30d retention is included in both scenarios as a baseline; 90d adds approximately $600–$900/month on the pilot depending on volume. Embeddings are modeled as a fixed + per-token marginal; I flagged the rows where embeddings dominate cost.

If you like, Rishi can provide a simple pilot invoice (PDF) showing the hosted vs dedicated line items and the conditional discount for a committed reserved window.

Next call: are you free Thursday 07/22 at 10am PT to review the calc and lock the pilot band?

Sergio

Attachment: Clearsense_pricing_calc_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 54 KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@clearsense.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing sanity check + pilot estimate and next steps

Emily / Sergio — looping in finance ops. We put together a pilot invoice draft (RI_pilot_invoice_draft_20270722.pdf) that maps the two scenarios Sergio described. Two quick operational notes: 

- Pilot billing cadence: monthly in arrears; we can do net-30 or net-45 depending on internal approvals.
- Pilot discount: we can offer a one-time 10% pilot discount on the first 90 days if Clearsense signs the pilot PO within 7 days. That reduces the effective $/1M on the Hosted baseline by ~10% during the discount window.

Rishi, FYI — if we go to Dedicated we’ll need a short SOW call to define GPU sizing; I’ll start a checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: RI_pilot_invoice_draft_20270722.pdf (PDF, 24 KB)
From: Emily Zhao <emily@clearsense.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing sanity check + pilot estimate and next steps

Appreciate the fast turnaround — the workbook looks helpful. We’re aligned to start with a hosted pilot in the 250M–600M range; procurement is aiming to issue a PO next week. A couple of asks before PO: 

- Please include a 30d observability retention line and a 90d option so procurement can choose.
- Can you add a small row in the invoice for a SOC2 evidence package (we may need it for our security review)?
- Please send a DocuSign link or editable PDF for the pilot agreement + invoice.

Confirmed: we’ll take the 10% pilot discount if we sign within 7 days. Let’s keep the 10am PT Thursday slot for a quick 30-min lock call — I’ll send a calendar invite for 10:00–10:30 PT.

Thanks — Emily
